Performance metrics with their denominators

tl_metrics.Rd

Computes every headline quantity together with its numerator, denominator, units, the time excluded from it, and an explicit reason whenever it is undefined. Results are given per record and pooled over records (ratio of sums, which weights records by their duration). Use tl_record_mean() for equal-record summaries.

Usage

tl_metrics(ledger, match = NULL, level = c("both", "record", "pooled"))

Arguments

ledger

A tl_ledger.

match

Optional tl_match; needed for episode and alarm metrics.

level

"both", "record" or "pooled".

Details

Definitions (all durations from the ledger; "known" means the reference is known):

  • answer_coverage: answered known time / known time.

  • answer_coverage_given_input: the same restricted to time with input declared available.

  • answered_sensitivity: correctly flagged event time / event time during answered time.

  • full_capture: correctly flagged event time / all known event time. Unanswered event time counts as missed; its reasons are reported as missed_*_min rows.

  • episode_sensitivity: detected / eligible episodes under the matching policy in match.

  • false_alarms_per_*_hour: alarms with no reference-event overlap per answered (or known) hour; unmatched_alarms_per_answered_hour also counts redundant alarms.

  • pred_burden_answered, ref_burden_answered: predicted and reference event fractions on the same answered time; ref_burden_full: reference event fraction over known time; burden_diff_pp is their difference in percentage points and burden_error_min in minutes.

  • burden_bound_lower, burden_bound_upper: the range of full-period predicted burden compatible with completing the unanswered time, keeping the answered labels fixed. This bounds the prediction, not the true burden.

Value

A data frame of class tl_metrics with columns level, record, detector, metric, estimate, numerator, denominator, unit, excluded_time (reference-unknown time left out of known-time denominators) and undefined_reason.

Examples

fx <- tl_fixture("acceptance")
led <- tl_ledger(fx$records, fx$reference, fx$predictions,
                 time_unit = "min")
tl_metrics(led, tl_match(led), level = "pooled")
